title: West Africa
tagline: West Africa and the colonial conquest

hook.deadpan: 1878. Most of West Africa is ruled by Africans. Europe is about to hold a meeting.
hook.epic: Thirty-six years. A region's map redrawn from outside.

beats: Berlin Conference opens
Europe holds a conference on Africa. No Africans are invited.
1884: in Berlin, Europe sets the rules for carving up Africa.
Ségou taken
France takes Ségou, capital of the Toucouleur Empire.
Ségou falls to the French.
Abomey falls
Dahomey fights France for two years, women soldiers included. Abomey falls.
Abomey burns. The Kingdom of Dahomey falls.
Kumasi occupied
Britain occupies Kumasi and exiles the Asantehene.
Kumasi: Britain deposes Prempeh I.
Benin City taken
Britain sacks Benin City. The bronzes end up in London.
1897: Benin City is taken and its bronzes looted.
Samori Ture captured
Samori Ture holds off France for sixteen years. Then he is captured.
Samori Ture, captured after sixteen years of resistance.
War of the Golden Stool
A British governor demands the Golden Stool. Yaa Asantewaa answers with an army.
Yaa Asantewaa leads the War of the Golden Stool.
Kousséri
Three French columns meet at Lake Chad. Rabih is killed.
Kousséri: Rabih az-Zubayr falls.
Sokoto taken
Britain takes Sokoto, seat of the Caliphate.
1903: the Sokoto Caliphate falls.
French West Africa federated
France merges its colonies and runs them from Dakar.
French West Africa: one federation, governed from Dakar.
Nigeria amalgamated
Britain joins two colonies together and calls the result Nigeria.
1914: Nigeria is created by amalgamation.
Togoland invaded
Europe's war arrives. Britain and France invade German Togoland.
1914: the First World War reaches West Africa.
end_card: Every year. Every border. Explore it yourself.
